_comment: Shipped inside the app and shown only until the phone first reaches Ceria's website. Keep this evergreen — nothing here should be a dated announcement. The live file is described in docs/news.md.

body.en: This is where Ceria posts gatherings, courses, and news for families. When your phone is online, the latest updates from the foundation appear here.
body.id: Di sinilah Ceria membagikan pertemuan, kursus, dan kabar untuk keluarga. Saat ponsel Anda daring, kabar terbaru dari yayasan akan muncul di sini.
